population_rule: All 2118 validation objects, no morphology or shape-success cuts. Same per-object mask for every method: intersection of JWST validity and strict bilinear/bicubic input support. Primary central 105x105 target-pixel crop (21 native pixels), matching Figure 5. Signed sky-subtracted physical intensities; no clipping, flux renormalization or band conversion. Each object has equal weight.

summary.rule: Resample spatial blocks with replacement, retaining all objects and methods paired. Equal object weights within the resulting population. Percentile 95% intervals; conditional on this field, validation selection and trained checkpoints.

timing_protocol.statistic: Median synchronized wall time per batch divided by batch size; range is min/max repeats, not a confidence interval.
timing_protocol.scope: Device-resident NISP inputs to physical-intensity outputs. Includes representation conversion, diffusion noise creation and ensemble averaging. Excludes disk IO, host/device transfers, metrics, interpolation validity-mask construction and model loading.

limitations: Validation-selected checkpoints, not a held-out test result.
One training seed per model; block intervals do not measure training-seed variation.
Cross-band and different-PSF agreement with a noisy observed JWST reference; pixel errors are not morphology or shear calibration.
Diffusion single draw uses seed 314159; mean3 averages three images in linear intensity.
Inference times reused from the original benchmark at batch size 8; no new speed comparison.
Reference-derived source masks depend on noisy JWST detections; selection can couple to reference noise.
Background means the complement of detected, dilated sources, not guaranteed source-free sky.
Empty source/background regions are excluded per region identically for every method; counts and IDs are saved.

protocol.rule: Smooth the full signed JWST reference with a normalized Gaussian; estimate median and sigma-clipped standard deviation from valid smoothed pixels at radius 70–95. Detect all 8-connected regions with at least 10 pixels above median + threshold*sigma; fill holes and dilate by a radius-3 disk. Intersect with common validity and crop to the central 105x105 pixels only after detection. Background is the complement within common validity. No per-model masks.
